data.one_liner: Grinder tasks for releasing Dart CLI packages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of Grinder tasks that automate releasing Dart command-line applications to various channels like GitHub releases, npm, Homebrew, and pub.dev. It handles creating standalone archives and integrates with CI environments.
use_when: You are building and releasing a Dart command-line application.
You want to automate publishing to GitHub releases, npm, Homebrew, and pub.dev using Grinder.
avoid_when: You are developing a Flutter mobile or desktop UI application rather than a Dart CLI app.
You do not use Grinder for task running.
strengths: Simplifies multi-channel distribution for CLI apps.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Grinder task runner ecosystem.
Limited applicability outside of Dart CLI packaging.
data.setup_notes: Import package:cli_pkg/cli_pkg.dart and call pkg.addAllTasks() before grind(args) in your grinder script.
